requirements.evidence: lang/pt_BR.json:862-866 adds entries with no comma after "Ilhas Aland" and a trailing comma before "}" (invalid JSON), using keys "reset.password"/"verify.email" instead of the required "Reset your password"/"Verify your email address"; app/Http/Controllers/Auth/VerificationController.php:16 extends Controller in namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth without importing it (fatal) and line 27 compares sha256 while VerifyEmail uses sha1; routes/web.php:278 lacks 'auth' middleware and line 20 does not check the logged-in user; PasswordResetController.php:65 'exists:users,email' reveals account existence; :87 missing letters/mixedCase/numbers rules; no guest middleware on routes; config/mail.php:165-167 points markdown paths at .../html/themes, so mail::themes.pegafila can't be resolved; .env.example not changed.

conventions.evidence: No tests at all, which goes against the project's TDD rule; no CHANGELOG/docs update; views resources/views/auth/*.blade.php are bare unstyled forms with no Bulma, no layout/component, and untranslated labels ("Password", "Confirm Password"); inline FQCNs in routes/web.php:271-278 instead of imports.

security.evidence: PasswordResetController.php:65 'exists:users,email' produces a validation error for unknown addresses, which allows account enumeration that the task explicitly forbids; :87 weak password rule (only min:8); routes/web.php:278 verification route has no 'auth' and VerificationController.php:20 verifies any user by id instead of the logged-in user; reset routes not restricted to guests.

tests.evidence: The diff contains no test files: nothing for the mail rendering, the routes, the non-enumeration behaviour, password rules or verification 403.

simplicity.evidence: Controllers are reasonably small and use Password broker, but the hand-rolled hash check duplicates framework logic incorrectly (VerificationController.php:27), and there are unused $status (PasswordResetController.php:67) and unused Validator import (:53).

readability.evidence: Commented-out import VerificationController.php:14; unused variable/import in PasswordResetController.php:53,67; mixed quote styles (:65); CSS placeholder comments 'Example button styling', 'Additional styling as needed' (pegafila.css:247,259); no newline at end of file; broken JSON formatting in lang/pt_BR.json:862.

scope.evidence: config/mail.php:126,134,142 removes unrelated 'scheme' and 'retry_after' settings and blank lines from the mailers config; this has nothing to do with the task and can change SMTP/failover behaviour.

issues.explanation: The edit makes the JSON invalid (missing comma, trailing comma), which breaks every pt_BR JSON translation, and it uses the wrong keys, so the subjects "Reset your password"/"Verify your email address" are never translated.
The class extends Controller inside the Auth namespace but never imports App\Http\Controllers\Controller, so loading it is a fatal class-not-found error.
It compares a sha256 hash, but Laravel's VerifyEmail URL uses sha1, so every valid verification link returns 403.
The 'exists:users,email' rule returns a validation error for unknown addresses, which reveals whether an account exists; the task requires always redirecting with passwords.sent.
The verification route lacks 'auth' middleware, and the controller verifies the user from the URL id instead of checking the logged-in user.
markdown.paths points at views/vendor/mail/html/themes instead of views/vendor/mail, so the mail namespace resolves to a non-existent .../themes/html directory and the pegafila theme cannot load.
There are no tests for any of the new behaviour, which goes against the project's mandatory TDD convention.
The password rule is only min:8; it is missing the required letters, mixed case and numbers rules.
The password-reset routes are not restricted to guests ('guest' middleware is missing).
APP_NAME/APP_LOCALE/APP_FALLBACK_LOCALE are not added to .env.example as required.
The brand color is set through a CSS custom property, which the CSS inliner and most mail clients don't resolve, and the theme drops every other default mail style.
It removes the unrelated 'scheme' and 'retry_after' mailer settings.
The views are unstyled forms, not Bulma, with hard-coded English labels in a pt-BR product.
A commented-out import was left behind; there is also an unused $status variable and an unused Validator import in PasswordResetController.
CHANGELOG.md and the docs are not updated.

review.summary: The change adds password-reset and verification controllers, routes, views, a mail theme and the phpunit pins. It breaks lang/pt_BR.json (invalid JSON with the wrong keys), the verification controller has a missing parent-class import and the wrong hash algorithm, and the reset endpoint leaks account existence. The markdown theme path is misconfigured, unrelated mail config was removed, and there are no tests, so the PR should be rejected.
